verdict.rationale: The evidence shows llama.cpp ships its own local server: a `llama serve -hf <model>` command, a 'Server' section, and a built-in web UI running against `llama serve`. Nothing in the pack states that this server exposes an OpenAI-compatible API or documents its endpoints, so the compatibility half of the story is unproven. missing for 10: explicit evidence of OpenAI-compatible endpoints (e.g. /v1/chat/completions), API documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of client compatibility.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for any loaded model

citations.quote: Built-in web UI against `llama serve` running Qwen 3.6
